    Questions

    Before you upload anything.

    No. Most creators on Web Academy teach what they have been practising for two or three years. What matters is that you can show finished work and explain how you got there.

    Nothing to start. We take 12% of each sale on Creator, or 8% on Studio. No setup fee, no monthly minimum, no charge for a course that never sells.

    Yes. Courses are yours and there is no exclusivity clause. Many instructors keep a personal shop and use Web Academy for the live side.

    You do. We hold a licence to host and stream it while your course is live, and that licence ends the moment you unpublish.

    On the 5th of every month, for everything sold in the previous month, to any bank account in the supported list. There is no minimum payout.

    Publish for free and use the audience tools to build a list first. If a course sells nothing in 90 days you can delete it with no fee and no question.
